Texts rewritten in his own style from the Arnhem mail he supplied the same day: name and what he builds first, goal stated plainly, one ask, one tree question. mails.found_at: drafts/woodland-trust-permission.md, address from the Ancient Tree Inventory site
mails.subject: Written permission to use Ancient Tree Inventory data
mails.body:
Hello,

My name is Hidde and I am building ancienttrees.app, a platform for remarkable
trees. My goal is to get people excited about old trees and to encourage them to
go outside and look at them.

Your licence asks for written permission before Ancient Tree Inventory data
appears on a public mapping site, so I am asking. I would like to show a
selection of ATI trees in UK cities, starting with London, credited as your
licence specifies and linked back to the Inventory. We would only publish trees
that are publicly accessible, and we always honour a location you withhold.

The site is free and has no ads, but I am building an app with a paid tier
later, so I will not claim non-commercial. I am open to whatever terms work for
the Trust.

And either way: which ancient tree do you think more people should go and see?

Kind regards,
Hidde
ancienttrees.app

mails.found_at: drafts/OUTREACH.md tier 1, address from the Generalitat's own dataset contact
mails.subject: Llicencia per al registre d'arbres monumentals
mails.body:
Hola,

Em dic Hidde i estic construint ancienttrees.app, una plataforma d'arbres
remarcables. El meu objectiu es que la gent s'entusiasmi amb els arbres vells i
surti a fora a veure'ls.

M'agradaria fer servir el registre d'arbres monumentals per ampliar Barcelona i
obrir Girona i Tarragona. Les metadades diuen unicament "otherRestrictions",
sense cap llicencia, i per aixo pregunto abans de descarregar res.

El web es gratuit i sense publicitat, pero estic fent una app amb una part de
pagament mes endavant, aixi que no dire que som no comercials.

Sota quines condicions el podriem fer servir, amb l'atribucio que indiqueu?

I en qualsevol cas: quin arbre de Catalunya creieu que la gent hauria d'anar a
veure?

Salutacions cordials,
Hidde
ancienttrees.app

mails.found_at: City of Sydney's own DCAT open-data feed: hasEmail mailto:Council@cityofsydney.nsw.gov.au, read 2026-08-16
mails.outlet: City of Sydney, Register of Significant Trees
mails.subject: Licence for the Register of Significant Trees
mails.body:
Hello,

My name is Hidde and I am building ancienttrees.app, a platform for remarkable
trees. My goal is to get people excited about old trees and to encourage them to
go outside and look at them.

Your Register of Significant Trees is the best tree data I have found anywhere,
and I would like to use it to build a Sydney page, credited to the City with a
link back. We would only publish trees your own data marks as publicly
accessible or visible from the street.

Your street tree data carries a CC BY 4.0 licence but the significant trees
layer has none, so I am asking rather than assuming. The site is free and has no
ads, but I am building an app with a paid tier later, so I will not claim
non-commercial.

Would you licence it, CC BY or whatever you prefer?

And either way: which tree in Sydney do you think visitors should see?

Kind regards,
Hidde
ancienttrees.app

mails.subject: Licentie voor het Landelijk Register Monumentale Bomen
mails.body:
Hallo,

Mijn naam is Hidde en ik bouw aan ancienttrees.app, een platform voor
opmerkelijke bomen. Mijn doel is om mensen enthousiast te maken over oude bomen
en ze aan te moedigen om die buiten te gaan bekijken.

Er staan nu dertien Nederlandse steden op de site. Het Landelijk Register
Monumentale Bomen zou ik graag gebruiken om die aan te vullen. De licentie is
CC BY-NC en daar loop ik op vast, dus ik vraag het liever vooraf.

De site is gratis en heeft geen advertenties, maar ik bouw aan een app met later
een betaald deel, dus ik ga niet zeggen dat we niet-commercieel zijn.

Onder welke voorwaarden zou het kunnen, met de bronvermelding die jullie willen?

En hoe dan ook: welke boom mis jij persoonlijk op de site?

Met vriendelijke groet,
Hidde
ancienttrees.app

mails.found_at: crfop.gdos.gov.pl/CRFOP/kontakt.jsf and gov.pl/web/gdos/kontakt, both give kancelaria@gdos.gov.pl
mails.outlet: GDOS Poland, Centralny Rejestr Form Ochrony Przyrody
mails.subject: Licence for CRFOP tree monument data
mails.body:
Hello,

My name is Hidde and I am building ancienttrees.app, a platform for remarkable
trees. My goal is to get people excited about old trees and to encourage them to
go outside and look at them.

I would like to use the pomniki przyrody records from CRFOP. This is a question
rather than a request: the portal metadata reads CC0, but the licence condition
fields are empty and the site publishes CC BY-SA for its own content, so I want
to know which applies before I use anything.

The site is free and has no ads, but I am building an app with a paid tier
later, so I will not claim non-commercial.

Could you confirm which licence applies, and how you would like to be credited?

And either way: which Polish tree do you think more people should go and see?

Kind regards,
Hidde
ancienttrees.app
